steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no work experience necessary. This makes CAPM ideal for career changers and early-stage professionals in Sandy Springs's growing logistics, automotive, and financial services sectors ready to formalize their PM knowledge.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format compresses CAPM training into a focused schedule, allowing you to earn your required education hours without disrupting your current role in Sandy Springs.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once coursework is complete, submit your PMI application and exam fee directly to the Project Management Institute. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and timely eligibility approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Ongoing learning keeps you competitive in Sandy Springs's dynamic project-management job market and demonstrates your commitment to the profession.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
